gloss.is: is — дієслово be: this is = це

clips.line: And finally, a Texas woman has filed a lawsuit.
clips.note: Seth Meyers tells a funny news story: a woman in Texas has gone to court with a lawsuit.
clips.noteUa: Сет Маєрс розповідає кумедну новину: жінка з Техасу подала позов до суду.
around: You guys, this is very exciting.

clips.line: Case closed. If we don’t find something conclusive, it jeopardizes the case and opens the department up to a lawsuit.
clips.note: Captain Holt explains why the case isn't finished: without strong proof, someone could sue the police department.
clips.noteUa: Капітан Холт пояснює, чому справа не закрита: без вагомих доказів на відділок можуть подати позов до суду.
around: So cancel your plans. We’re here until this is over.
